comments.text: Not a subscriber to the channel but really resepct your work. Muse told me to add photos to my Google Drive and it could access them there.  Really?  As a non-technical heavy user of AI I add screenshots to my photos all of the time to share design and even researched technical information with Claude, Codex, Grok Heavy, Cursor, Gemini, and even Hermes.  Claude and ChatGPT are the only ones who have access to Apple photos.  I know how to take screenshots and paste them in the chat, but why change what works for me. That is the value of machines getting smarter.  It isn't a "Bitter Lesson" for me to let machines solve the problems.  I think Dots just solved another BIG problem that "normies" like me have been waiting for.
